  <div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h1 align="center" tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">HolmesGPT — The CNCF SRE Agent</h1><a id="user-content-holmesgpt--the-cncf-sre-agent" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: HolmesGPT — The CNCF SRE Agent" href="#holmesgpt--the-cncf-sre-agent"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
  <p align="center" dir="auto">
    <a href="#installation"><strong>Installation</strong></a> |
    <a href="https://holmesgpt.dev/" rel="nofollow"><strong>Docs</strong></a> |
    <a href="https://deepwiki.com/HolmesGPT/holmesgpt" rel="nofollow"><img src="https://camo.githubusercontent.com/0f5ae213ac378635adeb5d7f13cef055ad2f7d9a47b36de7b1c67dbe09f609ca/68747470733a2f2f6465657077696b692e636f6d2f62616467652e737667" alt="Ask DeepWiki" data-canonical-src="https://deepwiki.com/badge.svg" style="max-width: 100%;"></a>
  </p>
</div>
<p dir="auto">Open-source AI agent for investigating production incidents and finding root causes. Works with any stack — Kubernetes, VMs, cloud providers, databases, and SaaS platforms. We are a <a href="https://www.cncf.io/" rel="nofollow">Cloud Native Computing Foundation</a> sandbox project. Originally created by <a href="http://robusta.dev" rel="nofollow">Robusta.Dev</a>, with major contributions from <a href="https://microsoft.com/" rel="nofollow">Microsoft</a>.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">New: Operator Mode — Find Problems 24/7 in the Background</h2><a id="user-content-new-operator-mode--find-problems-247-in-the-background" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: New: Operator Mode — Find Problems 24/7 in the Background" href="#new-operator-mode--find-problems-247-in-the-background"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Most AI agents are great at troubleshooting problems, but still need a human to notice something is wrong and trigger an investigation. <a href="https://holmesgpt.dev/operator/" rel="nofollow">Operator mode</a> fixes that — HolmesGPT runs in the background 24/7, spots problems before your customers notice, and messages you in Slack with the fix. Connect the <a href="https://holmesgpt.dev/data-sources/builtin-toolsets/github-mcp/" rel="nofollow">GitHub integration</a> and it can even open PRs to fix what it finds.</p>
<p dir="auto">While the operator itself runs in Kubernetes, health checks can query any data source Holmes is connected to — VMs, cloud services, databases, SaaS platforms, and more.</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><strong><a href="https://holmesgpt.dev/operator/deployment-verification/" rel="nofollow">Deployment verification</a></strong> — Deploy a health check alongside your app to verify the new version is healthy</li>
<li><strong><a href="https://holmesgpt.dev/operator/scheduled-health-checks/" rel="nofollow">Scheduled health checks</a></strong> — Continuously monitor services and catch regressions automatically</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Features</h2><a id="user-content-features" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Features" href="#features"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><strong>Petabyte-scale data</strong>: Server-side filtering, JSON tree traversal, and tool output transformers keep large payloads out of context windows</li>
<li><strong>Memory-safe execution</strong>: Per-tool memory limits, streaming large results to disk, and automatic output budgeting prevent OOM kills when querying large observability datasets</li>
<li><strong><a href="https://holmesgpt.dev/data-sources/builtin-toolsets/" rel="nofollow">Deep integrations</a></strong>: Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, Kubernetes, and <a href="#-data-sources">many more</a>—plus any <a href="https://holmesgpt.dev/data-sources/api-toolsets/" rel="nofollow">REST API</a></li>
<li><strong>Bidirectional alert integrations</strong>: Fetch alerts from AlertManager, PagerDuty, OpsGenie, or Jira—and write findings back</li>
<li><strong><a href="https://holmesgpt.dev/ai-providers/" rel="nofollow">Any LLM provider</a></strong>: OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure, Bedrock, Gemini, and more</li>
<li><strong>No Kubernetes required</strong>: Works with any infrastructure — VMs, bare metal, cloud services, or containers</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">How it Works</h2><a id="user-content-how-it-works" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: How it Works" href="#how-it-works"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
